nodes.label: Next.js Agent Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Warns coding agents of breaking changes in Next.js and protects auto-generated agent configuration blocks.

nodes.label: TinySet Dataset Generation Engine
nodes.rationale: Designs columns, finds matching entities on the web, and populates rows with values from real pages asynchronously.

nodes.label: Four-Step x402 Protocol Flow
nodes.rationale: 402 challenge -> off-chain sign -> facilitator verify & work -> on-chain settle & 200 receipt.

nodes.label: x402 Payment Protocol Specification
nodes.rationale: Revives HTTP 402 Payment Required for internet-native, accountless API micro-payments.

nodes.label: Arc Testnet Network
nodes.rationale: EIP-155:5042002 chain using pre-deployed USDC as native gas and payment token.

nodes.label: Multi-Chain Facilitator Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each chain has its own facilitator routing /verify and /settle requests while paying gas via transferWithAuthorization.

nodes.label: Whitechain Sepolia Network
nodes.rationale: EIP-155:2625 chain using test USDT for payments.

nodes.label: paidFetch Client Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Wraps native fetch to automatically negotiate 402 payment requirements and attach EIP-712/3009 payment signatures.

nodes.label: Whitechain Payment Facilitator
nodes.rationale: External verification and settlement service that validates signatures and broadcasts transfers on Whitechain.

nodes.label: Agent Safety and Isolation Sandbox
nodes.rationale: Restricts private IP navigation, prompts against credential entry, and uses ephemeral browser contexts.

nodes.label: Per-Row Pricing Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Charges 0.02 USDT (20,000 base units) per target row, settling payment when the dataset is created while fill continues in background.

nodes.label: Payment as Credential Pattern
nodes.rationale: Replaces accounts and API keys with per-request cryptographic payment authorizations.

nodes.label: Single-Use EIP-3009 Authorization
nodes.rationale: Uses random nonces and short expiry windows to prevent signature replay attacks.

nodes.label: Client-Side Spend Controls
nodes.rationale: Prevents rogue servers from requesting unauthorized assets or excessive payment amounts.

nodes.label: Deferred SSE Settlement
nodes.rationale: Streaming endpoints verify payment up-front but defer on-chain settlement until stream completes, returning receipt as an SSE event.

nodes.label: Gasless Payer Model
nodes.rationale: Payers only sign off-chain EIP-3009 authorizations requiring zero native gas tokens (WBT); facilitator pays gas.

nodes.label: Per-Chain Endpoint Routing (/api/<chain>/v1/*)
nodes.rationale: Prefix picks the asset explicitly so callers are never charged in an unexpected asset; legacy /api/v1/* returns 410 Gone.

nodes.label: Settlement on Success Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Requests are only charged upon 2xx success; 4xx and 5xx errors are never submitted for on-chain settlement.
